description: Pilot evaluation set: 15 question pairs across 5 categories. Korean is primary; English supplementary. expected.all_of = required tools; expected.any_of = at least one acceptable tool. Narrative references are provisional review guidance, not expert-adjudicated relevance labels. Verify numerical references against the frozen database before publication.

items.question_en: How many accidents occurred in each tunnel type?

items.question_ko: 사망자가 가장 많이 발생한 사고종류는 무엇인가요?
items.question_en: Which accident type caused the most worker deaths?
items.reference: 물체에 맞음 with 6 deaths, followed by 떨어짐 with 5. Total fatalities across all cases: 18.

items.question_ko: 해체작업 중 발생한 사고는 총 몇 건인가요?
items.question_en: How many accidents happened during dismantling work?

items.question_ko: 터널 공사에서 발생하는 사고 유형을 모두 나열해 주세요.
items.question_en: List all the types of accidents that occur in tunnel construction.
items.reference: Exactly 10 types: 물체에 맞음(70), 넘어짐(63), 떨어짐(55), 끼임(47), 부딪힘(40), 절단, 베임(17), 깔림(9), 찔림(5), 화재(3), 감전(1). '절단, 베임' is one single type.

items.question_ko: 안전수칙 미준수와 관련된 사고는 주로 어떤 작업프로세스에서 발생하나요?
items.question_en: In which work processes do accidents related to safety rule violations (안전수칙 미준수) mainly occur?
items.reference: Top processes: 설치작업 33, 이동 31, 해체작업 23, 조립작업 17, followed by 운반작업 and 정리작업 tied at 16 each. 안전수칙 미준수 is an L2 cause reached through its path-specific L3 sub-causes. These source-verified counts replace earlier values inflated by a shared L3 graph node.

items.question_ko: 가시설과 관련된 사고에는 어떤 세부 객체들이 있고 각각 몇 건인가요?
items.question_en: What sub-objects are involved in temporary-facility (가시설) accidents, and how many cases each?
items.reference: Sub-objects under 가시설 include 거푸집, 흙막이가시설, 비계 and others, with 거푸집 among the most frequent.

items.question_ko: 거푸집 해체 중 떨어짐 사고의 재발방지대책은 무엇인가요?
items.question_en: What are the prevention measures for falls during formwork dismantling?
items.reference: Grounded in real cases: measures such as 안전벨트/안전고리 체결 확인, 작업 전 안전교육, 안전발판 및 생명줄 설치, 관리감독자 배치. Must cite TA- case ids, not generic advice.

items.question_ko: 광차에 의한 사고 사례가 있나요? 어떻게 조치했나요?
items.question_en: Are there any accident cases involving mine cars (광차)? What actions were taken?
items.reference: Yes — 2 cases mention 광차. The answer should describe those cases and their 사고발생후 조치사항.

items.question_ko: 굴착 중 낙석에 맞은 사고 사례와 이후 조치사항을 알려주세요.
items.question_en: Show me cases where workers were struck by falling rock during excavation, and what was done afterwards.
items.reference: Cases involving 부석/낙석/토사 및 암반 during excavation, with post-accident actions (병원 이송, 작업 중지, 부석 제거 등).

items.question_en: What is a waler in tunnel construction?
items.reference: 띠장 = wale/waler: a horizontal temporary-works member in earth retention systems.

items.question_en: What is 숏크리트 called in English and what is it used for?
items.reference: 숏크리트 = shotcrete (sprayed concrete), used as tunnel support.

items.question_ko: 사망사고가 발생한 사례들의 공통점과 재발방지대책을 알려주세요.
items.question_en: What do the fatal accident cases have in common, and what are their prevention measures?
items.reference: 18 deaths total. The answer should identify patterns (e.g. 물체에 맞음 and 떨어짐 dominate) AND cite specific fatal cases with their 재발방지대책.

items.question_ko: 도로터널에서 가장 흔한 사고 유형과 그 예방책은 무엇인가요?
items.question_en: What is the most common accident type in road tunnels, and how can it be prevented?
items.reference: 물체에 맞음 (38 cases in 도로터널) is most common; prevention drawn from real case 재발방지대책.

items.question_ko: 지하차도가 정말 가장 위험한 터널 유형인가요? 근거를 들어 설명해 주세요.
items.question_en: Is the underpass (지하차도) really the most dangerous tunnel type? Explain with evidence.
items.reference: 지하차도 has 21 recorded accidents and 3 deaths, or 0.143 deaths per recorded accident; 도로터널 has 124 recorded accidents. Deaths per recorded accident is not the proportion of fatal accidents and is not exposure-adjusted risk. Without worker-hours, project activity or other exposure denominators, these records cannot establish which tunnel type is most dangerous.

items.question_ko: 굴착작업 사고의 주요 원인 경로와 대표적인 사례를 알려주세요.
items.question_en: What are the main cause paths for excavation-work accidents, and what are representative cases?
items.reference: Top cause during 굴착작업: 작업자 부주의 (9 cases). The answer should show the cause hierarchy and cite representative TA- cases.
